meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成图像,或基于参考图编辑合成新图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字想象变成图片素材,或对已有图片做编辑合成
copy.tagline_en: Generate images from text prompts, or edit and composite photos using reference images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn text descriptions into images or edit photos without design software.

howto.what: 你让 Claude 生成或修改图片时,它会运行技能脚本,把文字描述发给 OpenRouter 的图像模型,并将图片保存为 PNG 文件。也可以传入已有图片来编辑。需要先配置 OpenRouter API key。
howto.when: 当你要生成照片、插画、概念艺术等非技术类图片,或要编辑现有图片时触发。技术示意图(如流程图、电路图)请改用 scientific-schematics。

say.text: 画一张夕阳下山脉的照片,存成 sunset.png
say.note: Claude 会运行生成脚本并保存 PNG。

say.text: 用这张照片,把天空改成紫色
say.note: Claude 会以编辑模式调用脚本修改图片。

say.text: 用 FLUX.2 Pro 画一只在太空的猫
say.note: Claude 会通过 --model 指定该模型。

howto.what_en: Claude runs the skill script to generate or edit an image via OpenRouter image models, saving the result as PNG. It can also edit an existing image from a path. An OpenRouter API key must be configured first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for non-technical images like photos, illustrations, concept art, or edits to existing images. For technical diagrams (flowcharts, circuits), use scientific-schematics instead.

say_en.text: Create a sunset mountain photo, save it as sunset.png
say_en.note: Claude will run the script and save a PNG.

say_en.text: Use this photo and change the sky to purple
say_en.note: Claude will run edit mode on the image.

say_en.text: Draw a cat in space with FLUX.2 Pro
say_en.note: Claude will pass --model to pick that model.
